verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Workers keeps previously deployed versions and lets you roll back to one via Wrangler or the dashboard. That limits blast radius after the fact, but it is not an incremental rollout. Nothing in the pack shows percentage-based or gradual traffic splitting between versions. Missing for 10: documented gradual or percentage-based deployments, traffic splitting between versions, canary or monitoring-gated promotion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
